{"body": "`plans.py check` refuses every plan body in a repo whose direction gives a goal a measure (spec 027), so no goal plan can be checked, opened, or revised there.

## Reproduce

On `main`, whose `docs/product.md` has `measure:` lines under G-1 and G-2:

```
uv run --no-project python skills/product-intake/scripts/plans.py check tmp/plan-G-5.md
error: docs/product.md:22: not a `- G-<n>: <text>` item; run `shipmill product check`
```

Exit 2, before the plan body is read. `shipmill product check` accepts the same file.

## Cause

`goal_ids` in `skills/product-intake/scripts/plans.py` (lines 147-150) requires every non-blank line of a list section to be a `- G-<n>: <text>` item, so the indented `measure:` line spec 027 allows under a goal raises. `specs.py` and `pr_gate.py` already skip those lines; `tests/test_plans.py` has no case with a measure.

## Expected

`plans.py check` reads the goal ids of a direction whose goals carry `measure:` lines, as `shipmill product check` does, and still refuses a line that is neither an item nor a goal's measure.
